title.zh: 规定改善和开发薄荷省 Carmen 市镇巧克力山旅游景点的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Improvement and Development of the Chocolate Hills Tourist Spot in the Municipality of Carmen, Province of Bohol
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Improvement and Development of the Chocolate Hills Tourist Spot in the Municipality of Carmen, Province of Bohol

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7852_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Chocolate Hills tourist spot in the Municipality of Carmen, Province of Bohol, shall hereby be improved and developed in order to further enhance its tourism attraction and potentials.

The Department of Tourism, in coordination with the Philippine Tourism Authority and other concerned agencies of the government, shall prepare the development plan and construct the appropriate facilities and infrastructure for the area, subject to set tourism standards: Provided, That the development plan shall ensure the protection and preservation of the natural beauty and historical significance thereof.
The Department of Tourism shall take immediate steps to implement said development plan and incorporate the same in the Department's overall tourism development program for the ensuing calendar year.
The Department of Tourism shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.

This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
Approved, December 24, 1994.
